shortDescription: Rockstar Games’ Grand Theft Auto VI generated $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales, setting a record for the biggest entertainment launch across any medium, parent company Take-Two Interactive Software NASDAQ:TTWO said on Friday.Take-Two NASDAQ:TTWO said the game sold 32.5 million units before its…

children: generated $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales, setting a record for the biggest entertainment launch across any medium, parent company Take-Two Interactive Software

said the game sold 32.5 million units before its official release, setting a record across all platforms. It also claimed a Metacritic score of 99, describing the critical response as widespread acclaim.
The sales figures are based on company estimates through the end of November 19 worldwide, according to the announcement issued by Rockstar Games.
“It is with immense gratitude that we enter a new chapter of Rockstar Games with the release of Grand Theft Auto VI,” Sam Houser, president and founder of Rockstar Games, said in a statement.
Houser thanked players worldwide for their response to the release and said the company was excited to share the moment with them.
The game is available through the PlayStation Store, Microsoft Store, Rockstar Games Store, and retailers and storefronts worldwide, the company said.
carries an M rating for mature audiences from the Entertainment Software Rating Board (ESRB).
Shares were trading about 5% higher on Friday.

title: Take-Two says GTA VI posts record $3.79B in day-one sales
